programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Deportes
programme.desc: Platicamos con Ricardo Olavarrieta, expatinador artístico y pionero del deporte en México, quien nos comparte su trayectoria desde que descubrió su pasión por el patinaje a los seis años hasta representar a México en los Juegos Olímpicos de Invierno de Calgary 1988 y Albertville 1992. Además, comparte sus experiencias como competidor y especialista técnico, la creación de la Federación Mexicana de Patinaje y su participación en la formación de nuevas generaciones de atletas. Entre recuerdos de sus competencias, la emoción de estar en los Juegos Olímpicos y la evolución del patinaje artístico en Latinoamérica, Ricardo Olavarrieta nos ofrece una mirada inspiradora sobre la pasión, la constancia y la dedicación necesarias para sobresalir en un deporte de alto rendimiento.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Deportes
programme.desc: Conocemos el lado más humano y deportivo de Melvin Brown, exfutbolista profesional mexicano. A través de una conversación íntima y dinámica, el programa recorre su trayectoria desde sus inicios en Cruz Azul Hidalgo, donde el deporte formó parte esencial de su infancia, hasta su consolidación como figura clave en equipos como Cruz Azul y Jaguares, de Chiapas. Melvin comparte momentos decisivos de su carrera como su llegada a las fuerzas básicas del Cruz Azul a los 17 años, su debut en primera división, su experiencia en la Copa Libertadores del 2001, y cómo enfrentó lesiones, presiones y decisiones técnicas que marcaron su rumbo, como no jugar en el Mundial.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.sub-title: Paul Walter Hauser on Artist Friendly
programme.desc: On this week's episode of Artist Friendly, Joel Madden sits down with Paul Walter Hauser. From waiting tables to a Golden Globe, Emmy, and Critics' Choice Award for Black Bird — Paul Walter Hauser has built one of Hollywood's most distinctive careers by refusing to play it safe. Now starring in Fantastic Four and the new Resident Evil, he gets honest about fear, learning to say no, and why being his realest self matters more than chasing the next big role.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.sub-title: Stephan Jenkins of Third Eye Blind on Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Third Eye Blind frontman Stephan Jenkins joins Joel Madden to discuss songwriting, creativity, and the band’s upcoming album. Jenkins opens up about perfectionism, the struggle to finish lyrics, and the human element that drives his music. He also shares insights on producing, the influence of Eric Valentine, and gearing up for The Summer Gods Tour with Yellowcard and A R I Z O N A.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.sub-title: Pierre Bouvier of Simple Plan on Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Simple Plan frontman Pierre Bouvier joins Joel Madden for an in-depth conversation on balancing family and touring life, creative longevity, and the band’s continued success. They revisit their early 2000s pop-punk roots, reflect on 20+ years of friendship, and discuss Simple Plan’s special edition book with Alternative Press as the band enters one of its strongest eras yet.

programme.desc: Australian-Korean singer, rapper, and director DPR IAN joins Joel Madden to explore identity, imagination, and rebuilding yourself through art. programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with rapper-singer Lil Xan (Diego Leanos) for a candid conversation about therapy, vulnerability, and the hard work of getting healthy. programme.title: Christmas at the Amish Bakery (2023)
programme.desc: After leaving her Amish community in her youth, a New York book editor finds herself in desperate need of a new cookbook to save her job. With Christmas on the horizon Sarah heads back to her family farm to reconnect. But with the presence of a handsome local�an outsider, but one that is friendly with the Amish community�he and Sarah sense chemistry and work together to save her family�s Amish bakery (developing an Amish Christmas Cookbook in the process).

programme.title: A Cape Cod Christmas (2024)
programme.desc: Margot, a children’s book author, travels to the family beach house on Cape Cod for one last Christmas with her siblings. With her parents gone, her siblings want to sell. But Christian is a painter of much greater renown than Margot realizes, and they hatch a plan to keep the house she loves.

programme.title: A Very Corgi Christmas (2024)
programme.desc: All hard working single mom Lauren Bradley wants this holiday is a well earned rest. Her hopes are dashed when she runs into single dad Ben who asks her to help take care of a cute and cuddly Christmas present he's bought for his daughter. Through all the calls & interruptions work, she might just get the best gift of all, the holiday spirit.

programme.title: The Dog Who Saved Christmas (2024)
programme.desc: Zeus, a Labrador Retriever and a former police dog (voiced by Mario Lopez), has lost his bark after his barking ended up blowing off a five-year investigation, ending him at the pound. He is adopted by a father as both an early Christmas present and as a hopeful guard dog for the house and his family. When the family is away at Christmas, the less than dependable but crafty canine comes through and saves the home from two bumbling thieves.

programme.title: The Dog Who Saved Christmas Vacation (2010)
programme.desc: The Bannister family, including former K-9 police hero Zeus (voiced by Mario Lopez) are back, and this time they're spending their holidays at a beautiful Rocky Mountain resort. But toss in an unexpected visit from cocky Uncle Randy and his foxy poodle Bella (voiced by Paris Hilton) along with a familiar pair of bumbling jewel thieves, and this holiday may be headed downhill fast! Can Zeus solve the crime, save Bella and hit the slopes, all in time for Christmas Day?

programme.title: The Dog Who Saved Holidays (2012)
programme.desc: It's a sun-soaked holiday season for the Bannister family as they travel to Southern California to stay with Aunt Barbara, who surprises them with a new puppy named Eve. Everyone is smitten with Eve - except for the Bannister's dog, Zeus, who sees what a mischievous animal she is. When Zeus sees Ted and Stewey, two thrifty thieves, trying to break into the family home while the Bannisters are at church, it's up to Zeus and Eve to join together to save the holidays for their family!

programme.title: A Royal Christmas Tail (2025)
programme.desc: This Christmas, Riley Harper fights to save her small-town animal rescue from closing. Across the ocean, Prince Edward of Arendale travels to America to secure a land deal—unaware the property belongs to Riley. When fate (and a lost dog tag) brings them together, sparks fly. But when Riley learns Edward’s true identity, her trust shatters. On Christmas Eve, Edward risks it all to save her shelter—and her heart.

programme.title: A Christmas to Remember (2026)
programme.desc: As Christmas dinner preparations unravel, Lauren welcomes friends Megan, Paige, and lonely coworker Nora into her home. Through heartfelt stories of life-changing Christmases, they rediscover the power of kindness, authenticity, forgiveness, and chosen family. As her husband Tom finally arrives and dinner is served, Lauren realizes that the greatest holiday gifts aren't found under the tree, but in love, friendship, and second chances.

programme.title: The Christmas Brew (2024)
programme.desc: Overworked Tori is tasked with convincing a small-town brewery to sell to her employers, BEVCO, just before Christmas. However, she’s met with resistance from Evan, the charming brewmaster and owner, who rejects the offer. Stuck at his family’s bed and breakfast until she can persuade them, Tori discovers that the brewery’s true value lies beyond its beer, teaching her that some things are worth more than money.

programme.title: A Christmas Post (2024)
programme.desc: Noah Harrington is hired to revitalize a reluctant small town. When he finds undelivered Santa letters from the 1990s, he teams up with local historian Tessa Findlay to track down the long-lost gifts and bring early Christmas joy. As sparks fly between them, Noah hides one letter—Tessa’s childhood wish to ring the town’s Christmas bell before the post office is demolished. Can he save the bell, his job, and their budding romance in time?

programme.title: Christmas Keepsake (2023)
programme.desc: Single father, Tom and his daughter, Grace make the big move from the sunny land of Australia to the quaint US town of Ashbury Grove. While exploring her new backyard, Grace finds a mysterious time capsule, containing a guide to a perfect family Christmas. The two tasks themselves with finding its owner which leads them to finding love and their own perfect family Christmas.

programme.title: A Cape Cod Christmas (2024)
programme.desc: Margot, a children’s book author, travels to the family beach house on Cape Cod for one last Christmas with her siblings. With her parents gone, her siblings want to sell. Margot commissions her old friend and local artist, Christian, to paint a picture of the house as a keepsake. But Christian is a painter of much greater renown than Margot realizes, and they hatch a plan to keep the house she loves.

programme.title: My Christmas Prince (2017)
programme.desc: Samantha, a dedicated teacher, heads home for Christmas with her boyfriend Alex, whom she believes is a diplomat. But holiday cheer turns to royal chaos when she discovers he’s actually the heir to the throne of Madelvia. With his disapproving royal parents and her own dreams on the line, Samantha must decide if love is worth giving up everything she’s worked for to become a queen.

programme.title: Jingle Belle (2026)
programme.desc: Every year, high school sweethearts Isabelle and Mike delighted their small town with a Christmas duet at the annual Christmas Eve Pageant. After graduation, Isabelle left for Juilliard, leaving Mike behind. Years later, she returns home to write music for the beloved pageant and discovers Mike is directing the show. As old feelings resurface, they must put the past behind them and decide if they can make beautiful music together again.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.sub-title: Alleged Horse Abuse and Dog Rescue Gone Wrong
programme.desc: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. First, a mother and daughter face allegations of animal abuse and property damage caused by their two horses, as they sue the stable owner for their security deposit. Next, when a beloved rescue dog goes missing, a neighbor's car gets stuck in the snow while searching for him. A dispute arises over who should bear the cost of the tow truck bill.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.sub-title: Wage Wars and Golf Cart Goes Rogue
programme.desc: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. First, the husband and wife owners of a California production design company make the mistake of overpaying an employee by more than $6000. They seek payback for lost wages and emotional distress. In the second case, longtime golfing buddies dispute the 'negligent' moving of a golf cart that rolled down a driveway and slammed into a BMW.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: During her 78-day jail sentence, a woman claims her long-time 'friend' stole thousands from her bank account. He countersues, saying she had him falsely arrested for domestic violence.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: An ex-foster youth pursuing a career as a social worker sues her ex-boyfriend's parents after a house fire destroyed her belongings. programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.sub-title: Child Support Showdown and Dog Attack Drama
programme.desc: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. First, a mother demands payback from her ex-husband for their older son's medical bills and car repairs, claiming he agreed to cover these expenses. He refuses ongoing support for their adult child who lives at home and is employed. Next, a student seeks $10K for pain and suffering, as she dramatically alleges being bitten by her roommate's dog.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: Seeking $10K in dental bills, a nanny accuses an au pair of throwing a phone at her face and breaking her front teeth. The au pair suggests she seek dental repair at a more affordable location.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.sub-title: Wedding Bus Betrayal and Gun Violence Awareness Collision
programme.desc: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. Up first, a bride-to-be claims she is the victim of a bait-and-switch when she rents a large bus but a smaller vehicle shows up and ruins her big day. Next, the leader of a support group for gun violence victims sues a fellow member after her ATV is wrecked during an emotional awareness ride. The defendant denies accusations of drunken recklessness.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: A woman claims her neighbor's unleashed American Bully dog severely injured her dog, bit her foot, and caused her father to fall in the street. The neighbor insists that her smaller, 13-year-old dog 'Yogi' initiated the aggression.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.sub-title: Twin Tales of Assault and Retribution
programme.desc: A woman sues her ex-brother-in-law for damages from a violent street assault, while he countersues with the same allegations. The plaintiff's twin sister serves as a key witness as both parties seek thousands in compensation.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.sub-title: Child's View of Divorce Violence and Murder Trial Attire
programme.desc: Her Honor rules on two cases in this episode. Up first, a man sues the mother of his child after she allegedly keys his car during a visitation and later assaults him in front of their son. Altercations are captured on video. Next, after her son is sentenced to life in prison, a mother sues his attorney for failing to return expensive clothes she gave her son to wear during the murder trial.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: A man alleges that his ex stole money from him while he was incarcerated; she claims that the funds were utilized for shared household expenses. Both parties accuse each other of assault.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.sub-title: Guns, Ice, and Unpaid Price, and Renovation Roulette
programme.desc: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first, a 30-year drywall veteran sues his ex-employee for the remainder owed on a truck and for a gun taken without permission. In the second case, both parties vie for the $10K court maximum as a landlord claims that a contractor, whom he has never met, performed unauthorized renovations and placed a wrongful lien on his property.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: A man returns home from a business trip to discover that his girlfriend, whom he relocated from Ohio to Florida with her teen son, has left him for another man. He accuses her of taking his property and of the unauthorized purchase of a $2,200 designer bag.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.sub-title: Scooter Standoff and Dad's Work-for-Debt Dilemma
programme.desc: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. Up first, a woman sues her mobile-home neighbor over the sale of a mobility scooter and alleged harassment. The worker claims it was a generous gesture, not a loan.

programme.title: Judy Justice

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: Unwed parents sue each other for the $10K court maximum amid claims of assault, vandalism, and infidelity. With a second baby on the way, an alleged marriage-for-citizenship involving a Nigerian family member comes into play.

programme.title: Judy Justice

programme.title: Judy Justice

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: Car enthusiasts clash over an unpaid debt for prized car rims, a failed barter deal, and allegations of aggravated harassment.

programme.title: Judy Justice

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: A woman sues her former friend, claiming that she only had $100 left to pay off on a car before it was repossessed. Countersuing for an assault, her ex-friend submits evidence of a mutually-violent altercation captured in a live-streaming video.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: Two aspiring entrepreneurs from California accuse a man of failing to fulfill their order for custom t-shirts after full payment. The manufacturer claims mislabeled and allegedly 'unsellable' shirt issues are fixable.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: Unwed parents battle over the right to claim their child as a tax deduction and contest ownership of shared property. Child protective services intervene to ensure the toddler's best interests are protected.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: A driver burdened by parking tickets transfers ownership of his van to an unsuspecting friend to avoid paying fines. When he amasses more ticket violations, she repossesses the vehicle only to have it stolen; he sues for its return.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: A man refuses to pay the adoption fee for a sick Labradoodle puppy, claiming that vet bills far outweigh the animal's value. He admits to giving the pup away when the seller did not retrieve it and that he already has 22 other dogs.

programme.title: Judy Justice

programme.title: Judy Justice

programme.title: Judy Justice

programme.title: Judy Justice

programme.desc: In part two, a longstanding neighbors' feud reaches new heights, leading to court appearances, protective orders, and a barrage of vulgar conduct captured on camera.

programme.sub-title: Sentimental Silicon Bust and Sancho Showdown
programme.desc: Her Honor rules on two cases in this episode. In the second case, a dispute arises in a friends-with-benefits relationship as neighbors clash over a car loan and reimbursement for lost dresses.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: Competing lawsuits ignite between a tenant and her landlord, fueled by the loss of subsidized housing, drug accusations, and an eviction. Claims of property damage and accusations of running a puppy farm come into play.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: The $10,000 court maximum is at stake as an elderly landlord faces a terrifying arrest due to false accusations of gun possession. His tenants deny claiming that he aimed an AR-15 at them, while the landlord insists it was retaliation for his attempt to evict them.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: Former friends sue each other for the $10K court limit, after an altercation at a bar where one woman stabbed the other two. Claims of self-defense and counter-claims of harassment are further complicated by the fact that one defendant is now married to the plaintiff's ex-boyfriend.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: A mother seeks payback for wedding expenses from her daughter's ex-fiancé after he ended the engagement. He attributes the failed nuptials to the mother's interference and a contentious prenuptial agreement.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.sub-title: Assault, Corgis, and Emotional Support Fraud
programme.desc: Former partners battle over competing assault allegations and the custody of their two beloved corgis, one of whom makes an appearance and charms the entire courtroom. Concerns about the dogs' welfare arise when the Judge reviews a video of an online challenge where a slice of cheese is thrown on a dog's face.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.sub-title: Family Legacy at Stake and Rental DUI Delinquency
programme.desc: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first case, a woman sues her ex-partner of 25 years after enduring a forced eviction and alleged abuse in their shared home, which she had lived in since childhood. In the second case, a yoga instructor returns from abroad to discover that the woman who rented her car for three years had a DUI and installed a breathalyzer in the vehicle.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: Teenagers fight over an unauthorized 3-minute joy ride that results in a blown engine and sizeable repair bill. Blame shifts to the sports car owner when video evidence of a reckless, high-speed freeway ride is introduced.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: In a canine custody battle, a man brings his dog breeder friend to court over Gizmo, a French bulldog. The dispute uncovers ethical concerns about animal welfare in the breeding industry.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: In this two-part episode, a woman sues for damages to her car after a heated altercation between her grandson and the defendant. Tensions erupted when the grandson flipped off the defendant for honking at him for walking too slowly across the street.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: In part two, the conflict is reignited the next day when a knife is allegedly brandished, triggering a frantic struggle. In the chaos, the car sustains damage when the two parties engage in mutual combat ending in the arrest of both young men.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: A 31st birthday getaway to Tillamook, Oregon, takes a dark turn when a woman sues former friends for an alleged assault during a drunken argument. programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: Emotions run high when a woman sues her ex-boyfriend for custody of their rescue dog, Luka, who makes an appearance in court. He alleges mistreatment of the pomsky by her teen grandson, citing incidents of physical discipline and even spraying hairspray in the dog's eyes.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: A single mom from Vegas squares off against her dad's neighbor from Arizona over a disputed car deal. Conflicting stories emerge about whether they were more than friends.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: A man sues a former friend for thousands in property damage after his window is shattered during a late-night confrontation involving an intoxicated girlfriend and a botched apology.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.sub-title: Dangerous Passenger and Where Is Disney World?
programme.desc: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the second, a woman sues her niece for a Disney trip that fell apart after they mistakenly booked airline tickets to the wrong city in Florida.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: A woman sues a former acquaintance for selling her a faulty 20-year-old BMW, which broke down days after purchase. In retaliation, the man vandalizes the car, claiming she still owes money. She accuses him of odometer fraud.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.sub-title: Missing Cat Revenge and Sisterhood of Travelling Drama
programme.desc: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. First, a man sues his ex-friend for negligence after two cats entrusted to his care go missing.
